reason: When I need something like this I ring three local firms, get quotes and go with the middle one. A one-man outfit in Kuwait with no UK clients and a demo site for a made-up plumber wouldn't even make my shortlist, and pay-when-happy doesn't change that.
objection: He's not local and there's no one in Manchester who's used him. If something breaks on a Saturday I want someone I can actually reach, not a WhatsApp chat across time zones. And at £655 for a business my size it looks too cheap to be serious.
would_change_my_mind: A couple of real Manchester businesses like mine I could ring and ask about him, so he can sit in my three quotes as a proper option.
